properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for enforcing RBAC for fine-grained, least-privilege access to cloud resources
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to confirm that role-based access control (RBAC) is used to provide fine-grained access management of cloud resources in accordance with the principle of least privilege.
